headline: HSBC launches its RedCoin stablecoin in Hong Kong

scenes.vo: One of the world's biggest banks just put a stablecoin in an app with three point three million users. Here's what changed.
On Friday, HSBC switched on Red Coin, a Hong Kong dollar stablecoin, in its Pay Me app. It's licensed by Hong Kong's central bank and works at over one hundred thousand merchants.
Here's why traders are watching it. A giant bank is issuing a regulated stablecoin to everyday users. It's a real test of bank coins versus Tether and Circle.
The catch. It's still small, about eighty million Hong Kong dollars in circulation, and the first independent reserve check comes after year end.
Here's what happens next. Watch HSBC's daily supply number, and its planned tokenized money market fund.
